high_level_description: This image captures a serene scene at what appears to be a seaside promenade or plaza during the early evening or late afternoon. The sky is a gradient of soft blues and purples, suggesting either sunrise or sunset, with some clouds scattered across it. In the foreground, there is a prominent statue of a man walking, holding a staff or cane. The statue is mounted on a tall, rectangular pedestal, which has some inscriptions or text on it, though they are not clearly legible in the image. The base of the pedestal is surrounded by a circular platform, and there are steps leading up to it.
